verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-platform task assignment with deadlines and evidence collection. Its AI evidence gap analysis checks uploaded (manual) evidence for timeliness and flags outdated timestamps, which gives some owner, due-date and staleness handling. However, nothing shows a dedicated per-artifact manual-evidence workflow, recurring renewal reminders, or expiry-date tracking. Missing for 10: explicit owner and due-date fields on each manual evidence artifact, scheduled renewal reminders, expiry tracking and alerts for manual evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
